```{r}
do$do_sensor <- substr(do$sensor, start = 8, stop = 9)
do$do_sensor <- gsub('_','',do$do_sensor)
do_sensor_key <- read_excel("/Users/graceleuchtenberger/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Density_field/data/do_sensor_key.xlsx")

do_sensor_key$do_sensor <- as.character(do_sensor_key$do_sensor)
do <- left_join(do, do_sensor_key, by = "do_sensor")

do <- do[do$datetime < as.POSIXct("2025-08-29 10:25:00"), ]

```




```{r}
do_current <- left_join(do, current, by = "datetime")
do_current$up_Immersed <- ifelse(do_current$up_speed < 10,  "Y", "N" )
do_current$low_Immersed <- ifelse(do_current$low_speed < 10,  "Y", "N" )

do_current %>%
  filter(up_Immersed == "Y") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=datetime, y=DO_adj, colour = do_sensor))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()

do_current %>%
  filter(low_Immersed == "Y") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=datetime, y=DO_adj, colour = do_sensor))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()

```



```{r}
do_current %>%
  filter(bag == c(93:100))%>%
  filter(up_Immersed == "Y") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=datetime, y=DO_adj, colour = density))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()
```

```{r}
do_current %>%
  filter(bag == c(43:46, 27:30))%>%
  filter(low_Immersed == "Y") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=datetime, y=DO_adj, colour = density))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()
```
```{r}
do_mean <- do_current %>%
  filter(up_Immersed == "Y") %>%
  group_by(datetime, density, tide) %>%
  summarize(mean_DO = mean(DO_adj))
  
```

```{r}
do_mean %>%
  filter(tide == "L") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = datetime, y = mean_DO, color = density))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  ylim(0,20)
```
```{r}
do_mean %>%
  filter(tide == "H") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = datetime, y = mean_DO, color = density))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  ylim(2,20)
```

```{r}
do_mean_wide <- do_mean %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = density, values_from = mean_DO)

# Calculate differences
do_diff <- do_mean_wide %>%
  group_by(tide)%>%
  mutate(D_diff = D - C,
         S_diff = S - C,
         DS_diff = D- S) 

do_maxmin <- do_diff %>%
  group_by(density, tide, top_bottom, day)%>%
  summarise(daymin = min(mean_temp),
         daymax = max(mean_temp),
         .groups = 'drop') 
```

```{r}
do_diff %>%
  filter(tide == "H") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = datetime))+
  geom_point(aes(y=D_diff), color = "yellow")+
  geom_point(aes(y =S_diff), color = "green")+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0)
```

### Means of DO diffs (density treatment vs control)
```{r}
do_diff_H <- do_diff %>%
  filter(tide == "H")

do_diff_L <- do_diff %>%
  filter(tide == "L")

mean(do_diff_H$D_diff)
sd(do_diff_H$D_diff)
mean(do_diff_H$S_diff)
sd(do_diff_H$S_diff)
mean(do_diff_H$DS_diff)
sd(do_diff_H$DS_diff)

mean(do_diff_L$D_diff)
sd(do_diff_L$D_diff)
mean(do_diff_L$S_diff)
sd(do_diff_L$S_diff)
mean(do_diff_L$DS_diff)
sd(do_diff_L$DS_diff)

```


### Is there a difference between dense and sparse racks

```{r}
do_rack_mean <- do_current %>%
  filter(up_Immersed == "Y") %>%
  group_by(datetime, rack, density, tide) %>%
  summarize(mean_DO = mean(DO_adj))
```

```{r}
do_rack_mean %>%
  filter(tide == "L") %>%
  filter(density == "C") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = datetime, y = mean_DO, color = rack))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()
```

```{r}
do_rack_mean %>%
  filter(tide == "H") %>%
  filter(density == "C") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = datetime, y = mean_DO, color = rack))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  ylim(2,20)
```

```{r}
do_rack_mean_wide <- do_rack_mean %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(density, rack), values_from = mean_DO)

# Calculate differences
do_rack_diff <- do_rack_mean_wide %>%
  group_by(tide)%>%
  mutate(C_diff = C_S - C_D,
         D_diff = D_S - D_D,
         S_diff = S_S - S_D) 
  
```


```{r}
do_rack_diff %>%
  filter(tide == "H") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = datetime))+
  geom_point(aes(y=D_diff), color = "yellow")+
  geom_point(aes(y =S_diff), color = "green")+
  geom_point(aes(y=C_diff), color = "blue")+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0)
```

```{r}
mean(do_rack_diff$C_diff)
sd(do_rack_diff$C_diff)

mean(do_rack_diff$D_diff)
sd(do_rack_diff$D_diff)

mean(do_rack_diff$S_diff)
sd(do_rack_diff$S_diff)
```

```{r}
do_mean$day <- as.Date(do_mean$datetime)

do_maxmin <- do_mean %>%
  group_by(density, tide, day)%>%
  summarise(daymin = min(mean_DO),
         daymax = max(mean_DO),
         .groups = 'drop') 
  
```


```{r}
do_maxmin %>%
  filter(tide == "H")%>%
  filter(density %in% c("C", "D", "S"))%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=day))+
  geom_line(aes(y=daymin, color = density))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "darkorange", "gold"), labels = c("Ambient (no oysters)", "Dense (300/bag)", "Sparse (150/bag)"))+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 3, linetype = "dashed", color = "red")+
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Daily minimum DO (mg/L)", color = "Bag density")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(color="black",size = 20),      # Change x-axis title size
    axis.title.y = element_text(color="black",size = 20),      # Change y-axis title size
    axis.text.x = element_text(color="black",size = 18),       # Change x-axis text size
    axis.text.y = element_text(color="black",size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(color="black",size = 18),      # Change legend text size
    legend.title = element_text(color="black",size = 20))
```

```{r}
do_maxmin %>%
  filter(tide == "L")%>%
  filter(density %in% c("C", "D", "S"))%>%
  ggplot(aes(y = do_)) + 
  geom_histogram(alpha=0.2, position="identity")
```


```{r}
do_diff_long <- do_diff %>%
  subset(select = -c(C, D, S))%>%
  pivot_longer(cols = ends_with("diff"), names_to = "treatment", values_to = "DO_diff")


do_diff_maxmin <- do_diff_long %>%
  group_by(tide, treatment, day)%>%
  summarise(daymin = min(DO_diff),
         daymax = max(DO_diff),
         .groups = 'drop') 
  
```


```{r}
do_diff_maxmin %>%
  filter(tide == "L")%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=day))+
  geom_line(aes(y=daymin, color = treatment))+
  theme_classic()+
  ylim(-4, 0)
```

```{r}
  geom_histogram(aes(y = D_diff), fill = "darkorange")+
  theme_classic()

```

## Getting tide data going
```{r}
June_tide <- read_xlsx("/Users/graceleuchtenberger/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Density_field/data/DO/Jun_tide.xlsx", col_names = TRUE)
June_tide <- June_tide[-1,]
Jul_tide <- read_xlsx("/Users/graceleuchtenberger/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Density_field/data/DO/Jul_tide.xlsx", col_names = TRUE)
Jul_tide <- Jul_tide[-1,]
Aug_tide <- read_xlsx("/Users/graceleuchtenberger/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Density_field/data/DO/Aug_tide.xlsx", col_names = TRUE)
Aug_tide <- Aug_tide[-1,]

DO_tide <- bind_rows(June_tide, Jul_tide, Aug_tide)

colnames(DO_tide) <- c("info", "date", "day", "H_L", "pred_height", "pred_height2", "time", "data_range", "units", "datum", "disclaimer",	"EndDate",	"IntervalType",	"origin",	"producttype",	"state",	"stationid",	"stationidagg",	"stationname",	"stationtype",	"Timezone")

DO_tide$date <- as.Date(DO_tide$date)
DO_tide$time <- as_hms(strptime(DO_tide$time, format = "%I:%M %p"))
DO_tide$pred_height <- as.numeric(DO_tide$pred_height)

DO_tide$datetime <- as.POSIXct(paste(DO_tide$date, DO_tide$time), format="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")



```



```{r}
ggplot(DO_tide, aes(x=datetime, y=pred_height))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_line()+
  theme_classic()
```
